name: 2 · .agents/skills/code/references/types.md — null, sealed types, construction (G-B part 1; merges skel types-and-null.md + type-design.md)

items.title: No null decides a case
items.rule: No `null` decides a case: absence is an `Optional`, a sealed interface with records, or an enum.
items.source: pstack `ps/skills/principle-type-system-discipline/SKILL.md:15` ✓ (no bag of optional fields), `ps/skills/typescript-best-practices/references/patterns.md:28-36`; mattpocock: silent. pl 142 R:517-519, pl 143 R:376-378, JEP 441; ours RJ:14 (verified); Bad `aruvii-guardrails/.../GuardrailPipeline.java:43-50` (nullable optional tiers; R27 said :42-49).
items.recommend: adopt — every reference agrees; it is already an L2 MUST (RJ:14).

items.title: Closed set is sealed; switch has no default
items.rule: A closed set of two or more cases is sealed or an enum; a switch over it has no `default` arm.
items.source: pstack `…/principle-type-system-discipline/SKILL.md:20` ✓ (compiler checks exhaustiveness), `:29`; mattpocock: silent. pl 142 R:409-411,:463-465,:517-519; JEP 441; ours Good `aruvii-auth/.../AddMemberOutcome.java:13-23`, Bad `aruvii-api/.../PromptBuilderController.java:236` `default -> "event"` (both verified).
items.recommend: adopt — the compiler then names every site a new case must reach.

items.title: Construct the type; check only the rest
items.rule: Model forbidden combinations away with sealed variants first; a record's compact constructor rejects only the combinations the variants cannot exclude.
items.source: pstack `…/principle-type-system-discipline/SKILL.md:16` (types are constructions, not restrictions), `:17` (validate once at creation) — partial vs R25 TY3; mattpocock: silent. pl 126 R:2455-2457 (constructors fail fast); pl 122 R:241-243.
items.recommend: ADAPT (pending chat proposal) — pstack prefers a type that cannot hold the bad value over a runtime check; keep the check for what is left.
items.extra: Replaces R25 TY3 'compact constructor rejects every combination the domain forbids'.

items.title: Empty collection, never null
items.rule: A method returning a collection returns an empty one, never `null`.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. pl 121 methods:231-233; cursor-oop:243 (EJ Item 54).
items.recommend: adopt — sharpens TY1; no source disagrees.

items.title: Strengthen a type only where partiality shows
items.rule: Strengthen a type only where partiality appears — a cast, a null check, a 'never happens' throw. Elsewhere keep the plain type.
items.source: pstack `…/principle-type-system-discipline/SKILL.md:22,31`, `ps/skills/typescript-best-practices/references/patterns.md:86-108`; mattpocock: silent; others: silent.
items.recommend: adopt — the brake on TY1/TY3/TY8: stops wrapping for precision's sake (M20).

items.title: Nulls only at the wire (decided edge)
items.rule: A `null` is allowed only while mapping a wire DTO; it becomes `Optional`, a sealed case or an enum before it leaves the adapter.
items.source: pstack `…/principle-type-system-discipline/SKILL.md:18` ✓ (external data untyped until parsed), `ps/skills/principle-boundary-discipline/SKILL.md:14,24`; mattpocock: silent. pl 144 R:431-433 ✗ (`Map<String,Object>` until specific) — rejected; ours types-and-null §4 (`ErasureLookupResult`).
items.recommend: adopt — pstack's boundary parse is the same rule.

items.title: NullAway/JSpecify as the gate for TY1?
items.rule: Decide: does TY1 get a build gate (NullAway + JSpecify `@NullMarked`), or stay review-only?
items.source: pstack encode-lessons:15-21 (prefer the strongest mechanism); mattpocock: silent. jvm adityamparikh ext:203-238 (NullAway fails the build); R25 rejected `@NullMarked` everywhere (micronaut).
items.recommend: stay review-only now; open a spike ticket to measure NullAway noise on one module. A gate with thousands of first-run hits gets switched off.
items.extra: Options: (a) review-only · (b) NullAway on new modules · (c) NullAway everywhere. Facts: no gate behind TY1 today; R25 counted ~1.4k `== null`/`!= null` lines in main (count rots). Changes: (b)/(c) add an ErrorProne toolchain — none in the build today (verified: no errorprone in *.gradle.kts / libs.versions.toml).

name: 3 · .agents/skills/code/references/types.md — domain values, enums, final, generics (G-B part 2)

items.title: Brand an id that could be swapped
items.rule: Wrap a primitive in a domain type when two values of the same primitive type could be swapped at a call site, or when it carries an invariant.
items.source: pstack `…/principle-type-system-discipline/SKILL.md:17,27` ✓ ('two arguments share a primitive type but mean different things? Brand them'), `ps/skills/typescript-best-practices/references/patterns.md:84` ('not by reflex'); mattpocock `mp/skills/engineering/code-review/SKILL.md:49` (Primitive Obsession); pl 122 R:241-243 (invariants); pl 142 R:557-559.
items.recommend: REPLACE R25 TY8 with pstack's test (pending chat proposal) — the reason to wrap is swappability, not only an invariant (X4).

items.title: Contradiction: wrap for invariant vs wrap for swap
items.rule: Choose the test for a domain wrapper: 'carries an invariant' (R25 TY8) or 'could be swapped with a same-typed value' (pstack).
items.source: pstack type-system-discipline:17,27; mattpocock code-review:49; R25 TY8 / type-design §1.
items.recommend: take pstack's swap test plus the invariant test (TY8 above). Both mattpocock and pstack say an unbranded id is the smell; R25's test would allow `UUID agentId, UUID workspaceId` side by side.

items.title: final: fields always; new locals and params
items.rule: Mark fields `final` always; mark locals and parameters `final` in new code; never edit an old line only to add `final`.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. pl 121 classes-interfaces:153-155, pl 144 R:23 ✓ (fields); stephanj (locals+fields); airails ✗ (never on locals/params); GJS silent; ours RJ:13 'final wherever applicable' (verified); ST1 (ledger: `final var` on every local).
items.recommend: ADOPT (pending chat proposal, = OQ2 option b) — consistent with ST1; leaves old code alone.

items.title: Scope of final
items.rule: Decide the `final` scope: fields only · fields + new locals/params · everything.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. Sources split (stephanj yes, airails no, GJS silent); ours RJ:13; Checkstyle has no `FinalLocalVariable`/`FinalParameters` (verified @8f7bf163).
items.recommend: fields always + locals/params in new code (TY4). If it is to be enforced, add Checkstyle `FinalLocalVariable` per OQ3; leave `FinalParameters` off (it would flag every old signature).
items.extra: Facts: R25 counted ~1 in 5 signatures final on master (count rots); ST1 already makes every test local `final var`. Changes: option 'everything' needs a sweep or a ratchet; 'fields only' contradicts ST1.

items.title: Money is BigDecimal
items.rule: Money, cost and price are `BigDecimal` with explicit scale and rounding; `double` only for latencies and scores.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. pl 122 R:670-672; EJ Item 60; ours type-design §2 (#157 double paths still open).
items.recommend: adopt — no source disagrees.

items.title: Closed set is an enum, not a string
items.rule: A closed set of states, roles or modes is an enum, never a string literal; persist it as `EnumType.STRING`.
items.source: pstack `…/principle-type-system-discipline/SKILL.md:15` ✓; mattpocock `mp/skills/engineering/code-review/SKILL.md:49` ✓; pl 121 enums-annotations:44-46,:113-115; ours RJ:17; Bad `aruvii-tools/.../domain/ToolExecutionResult.java:25` `String status` compared as `"SUCCESS"` (`ExchangeToolHandler.java:151`, `ToolService.java:758`).
items.recommend: adopt — already an L2 MUST; the Bad is live.

items.title: Gate: enum compared to a string
items.rule: An `equals` between an enum and a `String` fails the build (ErrorProne `EqualsIncompatibleType` or an ArchUnit rule), never review.
items.source: pstack encode-lessons:15-21 (strongest mechanism); mattpocock code-review:41; ours fleet retro #61 row 14 (#622: enum `.equals("SUCCESS")` compiled and never matched); OQ3 (ledger).
items.recommend: adopt as a gate — it compiles, passes review and never matches; only a tool catches it. ErrorProne is not in the build today; an ArchUnit/Checkstyle check is the cheaper first step.

items.title: No raw types; narrow unchecked suppression
items.rule: No raw generic types. `@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")` sits on one statement with the reason it is safe, never on a method or class.
items.source: pstack `…/principle-type-system-discipline/SKILL.md:19` ✓ ('don't lie to the type system'), `ps/agents/comment-sicko.md:24` (suppressions of correctness rules die); mattpocock: silent. pl 128 R:61-63,:1504-1506; ours Good `GraphMailClient.java:85` (statement), Bad `GraphMailClient.java:146` (method level) — both verified.
items.recommend: adopt (R27 N5) — the only generics rule worth a line; PECS and CRTP stay teaching material.
items.drop: R27 'code/generics' reference not created: one rule does not earn a file.

items.title: No builders, no Impl (decided edge)
items.rule: Build a value with its record constructor or a static factory; no builder classes, no `Impl` suffix, no nested-class hierarchies.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. pl 123 java-design-patterns:110-112 ✓; pl 121 object-creation:85-87, pl 122 R:449-451 ✗ (builders) — rejected; ours type-design §8.
items.recommend: adopt — plinth's own pattern skill sides with us for small values.

name: 4 · .agents/skills/code/references/errors.md — outcome vs fault, error bodies (G-C part 1)

items.title: Foreseeable non-success is a sealed outcome
items.rule: A foreseeable non-success (not found, already exists, over limit) is a sealed outcome in the return type; only faults throw.
items.source: pstack `ps/skills/principle-type-system-discipline/SKILL.md:9` ✓ (define errors out of existence), `:22` (total functions); mattpocock: silent. addy `ad/skills/api-and-interface-design/SKILL.md:50,86` soft ✗ (throw NotFound; 'don't mix'); pl 143 R:31-32,:218-220; pl 126 R:1559-1561; ours RJ:21-27, Good `AddMemberOutcome.java:13-23`.
items.recommend: adopt — addy's point is consistency, which a sealed outcome keeps per method.

items.title: Fault = AruviiException + ErrorCode
items.rule: A fault throws `AruviiException` with a catalogue `ErrorCode`; no checked exceptions; never a bare `ResponseEntity…build()`.
items.source: pstack: silent; mattpocock: silent. addy `ad/skills/api-and-interface-design/SKILL.md:61-86` ✓ (one error shape, machine-readable `code`); pl 126 R:32,:2182-2186 ✓; pl 121 exceptions:95-97 / pl 126 R:1612 ✗ (checked exceptions) — rejected; ours RJ:18-20, GEH:66-71 (verified).
items.recommend: adopt — rejects plinth's checked-exception advice: the sealed outcome (ER1) already makes recoverable cases unignorable.

items.title: No Either/VAVR (decided edge)
items.rule: Do not use `Either` or VAVR; a domain-named sealed outcome carries the non-success case.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. pl 143 R:24-26 ✗ (VAVR required), pl 142 R:898-900 ✗ (hand-rolled `Either`) — rejected; ours error-handling §7.
items.recommend: adopt — a generic `L` loses the case names the switch reads.

items.title: Fix: errors are ApiResponse, not ProblemDetail
items.rule: Correct the API rule text: an error is `ApiResponse` with `success=false`, per ADR-0008; delete the ProblemDetail claim.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. pl 123 rest:44, pl 126 Ex14, pl 304 R:288, jf spring-boot-engineer/SKILL:185, jf java-architect/refs/spring-boot-setup:216-257 ✗ (all ProblemDetail); ours `docs/adr/0008-apiresponse-envelope-problemdetail.md`, GEH:71 `ApiResponse.error`, CLAUDE.md:260 still says 'errors are ProblemDetail (RFC 9457)' (verified).
items.recommend: adopt — five sources say ProblemDetail, but ADR-0008 is the decision and the code follows it. Ours wins; the false line goes.

items.title: Error body carries the ErrorCode message
items.rule: An error response carries the `ErrorCode` message only; never `getMessage()` from a library, driver or JDK exception, a stack, or SQL.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. addy `ad/references/security-checklist.md:202-216`, `ad/skills/security-and-hardening/SKILL.md:73,98` ✓; jf secure-code-guardian/SKILL:61; pl 124 R:27,:526-528; pl 123 rest:114-116; ours Bad `AgentController.java:186-190` returns the DB driver's constraint message (verified).
items.recommend: adopt — merges R27 N2 and R43 M21; the Bad is a live leak.

items.title: One exception→response mapper
items.rule: Map exceptions to responses only in `GlobalExceptionHandler`; a controller declares no `@ExceptionHandler`.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. pl 126 R:32,:2182-2186 ✓; ours GEH:34 javadoc still allows per-controller handlers; 15 main files carry `@ExceptionHandler` besides GEH (R27 said 14; count rots), e.g. `AgentController.java:162-190`.
items.recommend: adopt for new code only; migration of existing handlers is OQ-R27-1.

items.title: Migrate per-controller handlers?
items.rule: Decide: migrate every per-controller `@ExceptionHandler` into GEH now, or apply ER11 to new code only?
items.source: pl 126 R:2182; ours `AgentController.java:162-190` (also the ER10 leak).
items.recommend: new code only, plus fix `AgentController:186-190` now as a bug (it leaks driver text). A sweep is its own /crq ticket.
items.extra: Options: (a) sweep all · (b) new code + the leaking one · (c) new code only. Changes: (a) touches ~15 controllers' error statuses — needs IT coverage first.

items.title: Chain the cause; no empty catch
items.rule: A rethrown exception chains its cause; a caught exception is handled, rethrown or logged with its class name — never an empty block.
items.source: pstack `ps/skills/interrogate/references/rubric.md:10` ✓ ('silently swallowed?'); mattpocock: silent. pl 126 R:27,:584-586,:1873-1875; pl 121 exceptions:329-331; GJS 6.2; ours Bad `ChatOrchestrator.java:226` `catch (Exception ignored)` (verified).
items.recommend: adopt.

items.title: Catch the narrowest type
items.rule: Catch the narrowest type; `catch (Exception)` only at a must-not-fail boundary, with a comment; never `Throwable`.
items.source: pstack: `ctk/skills/deslop/SKILL.md:13` ✓ (try/catch abnormal on trusted paths — pstack's guide points to it, `ps/docs/guide/05-build-and-clean.md:51`); mattpocock: silent. pl 126 R:23,:2371-2373.
items.recommend: adopt.

items.title: Restore the interrupt
items.rule: When you catch `InterruptedException`, restore the flag with `Thread.currentThread().interrupt()` or rethrow.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. pl 125 #9; pl 126 R:28,:818-820; ours Good `ChatStreamConsumer.java:195` (verified; R27 said :197).
items.recommend: adopt — a swallowed interrupt is a quiet hang.

items.title: Validate at the boundary
items.rule: Validate request input at the boundary with Bean Validation; inside, trust the types and use `requireNonNull` only for programming errors.
items.source: pstack `ps/skills/principle-boundary-discipline/SKILL.md:9-24` ✓, `:24` (no redundant nil checks inside), `ps/skills/interrogate/references/rubric.md:36`; mattpocock: silent. addy `ad/skills/api-and-interface-design/SKILL.md:88-122`; jf spring-boot-engineer/SKILL:181; pl 124 R:23; pl 126 R:25.
items.recommend: adopt, wording sharpened toward pstack: inside the boundary trust the type (see DS8 for the guard ban).

items.title: Best-effort side calls (decided edge)
items.rule: A best-effort metric or audit call may catch and continue; it logs at WARN with the exception class, never an empty block.
items.source: addy `ad/skills/observability-and-instrumentation/SKILL.md:75`, `ad/references/observability-checklist.md:30` ✓ (warn = degraded but handled); pstack, mattpocock: silent; ours Bad `ChatOrchestrator.java:226`.
items.recommend: adopt with WARN, not DEBUG (X5).

items.title: Contradiction: best-effort catch at DEBUG vs WARN
items.rule: Choose the level for a swallowed best-effort failure: DEBUG (R25 edge 8) or WARN (addy).
items.source: addy observability SKILL:75, checklist:30; R25 G-C edge 8.
items.recommend: WARN. DEBUG is off in production, so a broken metric path would be invisible to the on-call customer (CLAUDE.md:294-300). If it is noisy, rate-limit the log line; do not hide it.

items.title: No banners
items.rule: Write no banner or divider comments, in any file type.
items.source: pstack `ps/agents/comment-sicko.md:12` ✓; mattpocock: silent; ours comments §1.
items.recommend: adopt.

items.title: No restating comments
items.rule: Write no comment that restates the code, a dependency or a config value.
items.source: pstack `ps/agents/comment-sicko.md:12` ✓; `ctk/skills/deslop/SKILL.md:12`; oc `.agents/skills/deslop/SKILL.md:14`; mattpocock: silent; addy `ad/skills/code-simplification/SKILL.md:144`, `ad/skills/code-review-and-quality/SKILL.md:46-47`.
items.recommend: adopt.

items.title: A kept comment names an outside constraint
items.rule: A comment survives only for a constraint the code cannot show: an external dependency or protocol, a public-API contract, a license, or an issue/RFC link. Otherwise reshape the code.
items.source: pstack `ps/agents/comment-sicko.md:14-22,28` (keep-list), `ps/skills/no-comments/SKILL.md:20-23`; pstack `ps/skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md:113` (author may write a why); mattpocock: silent. addy `ad/skills/code-simplification/SKILL.md:145` (why-comments ok); ours comments §4-5.
items.recommend: ADAPT R25 CM3 toward pstack's keep-list (X1).

items.title: Contradiction: why-comments about our own code
items.rule: Choose: may a comment explain a why about our own code (R25 CM3, addy), or must the code be reshaped so the why is obvious (pstack)?
items.source: pstack comment-sicko:14-22,28 vs poteto-mode:113; addy code-simplification:145.
items.recommend: pstack's two-tier form: the author may write a why while working; the reviewer deletes it unless it names an outside constraint, and flags the symbol to rename/extract/type. Our P1 F3 (false header comment, V106) shows why-comments rot.

items.title: A factual comment is checked, or encoded
items.rule: Check a comment's factual claim before it lands; encode a 'do not remove' or 'talk to X first' constraint as a type, test or lint, then delete the comment.
items.source: pstack `ps/agents/comment-sicko.md:26` (run /how, /why on the claim), `ps/skills/no-comments/SKILL.md:23`, `ps/skills/principle-encode-lessons-in-structure/SKILL.md:13-21`, `ps/skills/interrogate/references/rubric.md:30`; mattpocock: silent; ours comments §7.
items.recommend: adopt — merges R25 CM4 with R43 M10.

items.title: Javadoc on the interface only when not obvious
items.rule: Write Javadoc on an interface only when its contract is not obvious from the signature; write none on its implementation.
items.source: pstack `ps/agents/comment-sicko.md:19` ✓ (public-API contract docs survive); mattpocock `mp/skills/engineering/codebase-design/SKILL.md:16` ✓ (interface = invariants + error modes); GJS 7.3 ✗ (javadoc on every visible member) — decided edge; pl 126 R:29 (`@throws`) moot — 0 checked exceptions.
items.recommend: adopt.

items.source: TS tsconfig reference; not in `strict` or Angular CLI defaults; would catch `LUCIDE[name]`-style lookups.
items.recommend: measure the error count first (R26 Q3); no rule until then.

items.title: Object arguments (dropped)
items.rule: Pass an object instead of positional arguments, except on hot paths.
items.source: pstack `ps/skills/typescript-best-practices/SKILL.md:27`; mattpocock: silent.
items.recommend: drop.
items.drop: R43 M19: style preference with no Bad in our code; Angular signal APIs are positional.

items.title: Standalone only; omit standalone:true
items.rule: Write standalone components only, never an NgModule; do not write `standalone: true` (the v21 default).
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. Angular best-practices.md:11-12 @21.0.3; jf angular-architect/SKILL:126,136; ours CLAUDE.md:248.
items.recommend: REWRITE E9; remove the flag when a file is touched (OQ-NG6).

items.title: OnPush on every component
items.rule: Every component sets `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`; the app is zoneless.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. Angular best-practices.md:29 @21.0.3; jf angular-architect/SKILL:128; ours about half the components today (33 files; count rots).
items.recommend: adopt; add `prefer-on-push-component-change-detection` explicitly (not in angular-eslint recommended).

items.title: Derive with computed; effect only for side effects
items.rule: Hold component state in `signal()`, derived state in `computed()`; use `effect()` only for side effects, never to copy state.
items.source: pstack `ps/skills/principle-minimize-reader-load/SKILL.md:19` ✓ ('derive instead of sync'); mattpocock: silent; jf angular-architect/SKILL:127; angular.dev effect guide.
items.recommend: adopt.

items.title: Signal inputs and host object
items.rule: Use `input()`, `output()`, `model()`, `viewChild()` and `host: {}`; never the `@Input/@Output/@ViewChild/@HostListener/@HostBinding` decorators.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. Angular best-practices.md:15,28; ours Bad `shared/select.component.ts:198,205` `@HostListener`.
items.recommend: adopt for new or touched code.

items.title: A component renders; logic lives in a service
items.rule: A component renders; HTTP and business logic live in a `core/` service. A file crossing 1000 lines is a finding (DS2).
items.source: pstack `ps/skills/principle-boundary-discipline/SKILL.md:27` ✓; pstack `ps/skills/interrogate/references/code-quality-review.md:23` (1000); addy `ad/skills/frontend-ui-engineering/SKILL.md:322` (200); mattpocock: silent; ours `eslint.config.js:56` max-lines 600 warn.
items.recommend: ADAPT — fix the threshold citation (X3).

items.title: Contradiction: the 600-line threshold
items.rule: Choose the component size threshold: 600 (eslint today, mis-cited to addy), 200 (addy) or 1000 (pstack, addy review)?
items.source: addy frontend-ui-engineering:322 says 200, not 600; pstack code-quality-review:23,43 and addy code-review-and-quality:113 say 1000.
items.recommend: one threshold for Java and TS: 1000-line review finding (DS2). Keep eslint `max-lines` 600 as a warn-only nudge and stop citing addy for it.

items.title: Forms
items.rule: Decide: a forms rule now (Reactive on v21) or wait for v22 Signal Forms?
items.source: Angular best-practices.md:31 @21.0.3 (Reactive) vs main (Signal Forms); ours template-driven throughout, 0 reactive.
items.recommend: no forms rule until the v22 upgrade; then Signal Forms for new forms (R26 Q1).

items.title: standalone:true removal
items.rule: Decide: sweep every `standalone: true`, or remove when touched?
items.source: ours 70 files carry it (R26 said 68; count rots).
items.recommend: remove when touched; no sweep (R26 Q6).

items.title: inject() in a field initialiser
items.rule: Inject with `inject()` in a field initialiser; never through constructor parameters.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. Angular style guide §DI; best-practices.md:55.
items.recommend: adopt (codify; code already does it).

items.title: HTTP in a root service, unwrapped
items.rule: HTTP lives in a `providedIn: 'root'` service in `core/` that returns `Observable<T>` unwrapped from `ApiResponse<T>`; a component never injects `HttpClient`.
items.source: mattpocock `mp/skills/engineering/tdd/mocking.md:37-53` ✓ (one SDK-style function per endpoint); pstack `ps/skills/principle-boundary-discipline/SKILL.md:23` ✓; ours Good `core/agent.service.ts:16-26`.
items.recommend: adopt (2 auth exceptions to fix when touched).

items.title: takeUntilDestroyed for long subscriptions
items.rule: Bind a subscription that outlives one HTTP call (router events, interval, SSE) with `takeUntilDestroyed()`.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. addy `ad/references/performance-checklist.md:236` ✓; jf angular-architect/SKILL:137; angular.dev rxjs-interop.
items.recommend: adopt. Decided edge: a one-shot HTTP call completes itself.

items.title: Never swallow an error
items.rule: An error branch calls `toast.error(...)` or sets an error state; never `error: () => {}`.
items.source: pstack `ps/skills/interrogate/references/rubric.md:10` ✓; mattpocock: silent; addy `ad/skills/frontend-ui-engineering/SKILL.md:324` ✓; jf angular-architect/SKILL:130,138; ours Bad `features/agents/agent-list.component.ts:1074-1078` (verified).
items.recommend: ADAPT — drop R26's 'one-line reason saves an empty branch' (X1/CM3): a best-effort branch logs or sets state, like ER8.
items.drop: R43 M33 (no console.log, structured logger) dropped: `no-console` is already an error at `eslint.config.js:53`.

items.title: Native control flow
items.rule: Use `@if`, `@for (track)`, `@switch`, `[class.x]` and `[style.x]`; never `*ngIf/*ngFor`, `ngClass/ngStyle` or `CommonModule`.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. Angular best-practices.md:35-37,50; jf angular-architect/SKILL:131 ✗ stale (pre-v17 `*ngFor`) — ignored.
items.recommend: adopt (codify).

items.title: Clickable means button
items.rule: Anything clickable is a `<button type="button">` (or `<a>` for navigation), never a clickable `div`, `span` or `tr`.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. addy `ad/references/accessibility-checklist.md:57-67`, `ad/skills/frontend-ui-engineering/SKILL.md:180-196` ✓; Angular best-practices.md:22-23; ours Bad `shared/select.component.ts:44,49` (verified).
items.recommend: adopt.

items.title: Icon-only button has aria-label
items.rule: An icon-only button carries `aria-label`; `title` alone is not enough.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. addy `ad/references/accessibility-checklist.md:28`, `ad/skills/frontend-ui-engineering/SKILL.md:198-202` ✓; jf angular-architect/SKILL:139.
items.recommend: adopt.

items.title: Accessibility lint fallout
items.rule: Decide the levels when `templateAccessibility` is turned on: all `error`, or two rules at `warn` with a count?
items.source: angular-eslint CONFIGURING_ESLINT.md:50-114; ours ~37 clickable non-buttons (R26; count rots).
items.recommend: `click-events-have-key-events` and `interactive-supports-focus` at warn with the count in the comment (NGF4); the rest at error (R26 Q2).

items.title: app-icon only
items.rule: Render an icon with `<app-icon name>` from the `LUCIDE` map; never emoji or unicode symbols, `<mat-icon>`, FontAwesome or an icon package.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. ours `.claude/rules/angular-ui.md:8` (verified); Bad `features/settings/settings.component.ts:688-695` 🗑 as the button's only content (R26 said :655-662; shifted).
items.recommend: KEEP + tighten to 'unicode symbols'.

items.title: Icon dropdowns use app-select
items.rule: A dropdown whose options show icons is `<app-select>`; a text-only dropdown stays a native `<select>`.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. ours `.claude/rules/angular-ui.md:9`.
items.recommend: keep.

items.title: Colour an icon through its parent
items.rule: Colour an icon with `[style.color]` on its parent using a theme token (`var(--…)`); `app-icon` has no `stroke` input.
items.source: pstack, mattpocock: silent. addy `ad/skills/frontend-ui-engineering/SKILL.md:172,323` soft ✗ (inline styles are a red flag; use semantic tokens); ours `.claude/rules/angular-ui.md:10`, `shared/icon.component.ts:104`.
items.recommend: keep, with 'theme token' added to meet addy's point.

items.title: agent-icon is exempt (decided edge)
items.rule: `agent-icon.component.ts` (Heroicons agent-card picker) is exempt from NGE1; do not unify it.
items.source: ours `.claude/rules/angular-ui.md:11`.

items.rule: Decide: type `IconComponent.name` as `keyof typeof LUCIDE` so a typo fails the build?

items.recommend: yes, own /crq (R26 Q4) — it turns a review check into a compile error (OQ3 spirit).

items.rule: Decide: sweep the existing emoji icons now, or fix the template you are editing?

items.recommend: one /crq chore for the sweep; the rule applies to new code from approval (R26 Q5).

items.title: Extend recommended configs; lint inline templates
items.rule: Extend `tseslint.configs.recommended`, angular `tsRecommended`, `templateRecommended` and `templateAccessibility`, with the inline-template processor.
items.source: pstack `ps/skills/principle-encode-lessons-in-structure/SKILL.md:19` ✓; mattpocock: silent. angular-eslint CONFIGURING_ESLINT.md:50-114; ours zero template linting on inline templates today (R26 §2.2).

items.title: Header lists only enforced rules
items.rule: The `eslint.config.js` header lists only rules the config enforces.
items.source: ours `eslint.config.js:13-14` claims standalone-only and lazy routes are enforced — neither is configured (verified); #147.
items.recommend: adopt.

items.title: No cross-feature imports
items.rule: `features/X` never imports `features/Y`; generate one boundary zone per feature from the directory list.
items.source: mattpocock `mp/skills/in-progress/setup-ts-deep-modules/SKILL.md:26-35` ✓; pstack: silent; addy `ad/agents/code-reviewer.md:29`; ours `eslint.config.js:62-100` names 4 of 20 features.
items.recommend: adopt.

items.title: A new lint rule lands at error
items.rule: A newly enabled lint rule lands at `error` with existing hits fixed, or at `warn` with the hit count in its comment.
items.source: pstack `ps/skills/principle-encode-lessons-in-structure/SKILL.md:19` ✓ (partial: the strongest mechanism fails CI); mattpocock: silent.
